name: daniel-locatelli-portfolio
description: Read-only access to Daniel Locatelli's portfolio: projects, research, his full profile, and keyword search.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List portfolio projects with title, summary, URL, and start date.

tools.name: list_research
tools.description: List research entries with title, summary, URL, and start date.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Keyword search over Daniel Locatelli's profile (roles, education, research, projects, publications, talks). Best for names and topics such as 'DOKwood', 'Revit plugin' or 'timber'; for broad questions about his career, call get_profile instead. Returns up to 20 matches with title, section, URL, snippet, and a 0-1 relevance score.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Daniel Locatelli's whole profile as one markdown document (about 13k tokens): every role with what he did there, education, and a summary and link for every research page, project, publication and talk. The text the homepage chat answers from; use it for broad questions.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch any daniellocatelli.com page as plain markdown.
